steps.title: Warm DAB to Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Remove DAB from the –20 °C freezer and allow it to equilibrate to room temperature for 15 minutes before weighing. DAB must be handled in a fume hood because it is a suspected carcinogen.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % H₂O₂ Solution
steps.instruction: Using a conical tube, add Milli‑Q water and 30 % H₂O₂ in the proportions shown in Table 1. Mix gently. Table 1 provides three common final volumes:

substeps.instruction: Final volume 1.5 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 50 µl, Milli‑Q water: 1.45 ml
Final volume 3 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 100 µl, Milli‑Q water: 2.90 ml
Final volume 10 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 333.3 µl, Milli‑Q water: 9.67 ml

steps.title: Prepare 0.05 % DAB IHC Working Solution
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, weigh the amount of DAB listed in Table 2 for the desired final volume (0.5 mg ml⁻¹) and transfer it to a container containing 1X TNT. Vortex or stir on a stir plate until no visible particles remain. Do NOT add H₂O₂ yet; add the appropriate volume of the 1 % H₂O₂ solution (Table 1) immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Table 2 (0.05 % DAB, 0.5 mg ml⁻¹):
• Final volume 10 ml → 1X TNT: 10 ml, DAB: 5 mg, 1 % H₂O₂: 100 µl
• Final volume 60 ml → 1X TNT: 60 ml, DAB: 30 mg, 1 % H₂O₂: 600 µl
• Final volume 100 ml → 1X TNT: 983.3 ml, DAB: 500 mg, 1 % H₂O₂: 10 ml

steps.title: Prepare 0.03 % H₂O₂ Solution
steps.instruction: Add Milli‑Q water and 30 % H₂O₂ to a conical tube in the ratios shown in Table 3. Mix gently. Two sets of volumes are provided:

substeps.instruction: Table 3A (final volumes 40 ml, 50 ml, 75 ml):
• 40 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 40 µl, Milli‑Q water: 40 ml
• 50 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 50 µl, Milli‑Q water: 50 ml
• 75 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 75 µl, Milli‑Q water: 75 ml
Table 3B (final volumes 1 ml, 5 ml, 10 ml):
• 1 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 10 µl, Milli‑Q water: 1 ml
• 5 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 50 µl, Milli‑Q water: 5 ml
• 10 ml → 30 % H₂O₂: 100 µl, Milli‑Q water: 10 ml

steps.title: Prepare 0.05 % DAB for AChE (DAB‑) Solution
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, weigh the DAB amount listed in Table 4 for the desired final volume and dissolve it in 0.1 M Tris‑HCl (Table 4). Vortex or stir on a stir plate until clear. Aliquot the solution into two containers: one will remain DAB‑ (no H₂O₂) and the other will become DAB + (H₂O₂) when needed.

substeps.instruction: Table 4 (0.05 % DAB‑, 0.5 mg ml⁻¹):
• Final volume 800 ml → 0.1 M Tris‑HCl: 800 ml, DAB: 400 mg
• Final volume 1000 ml → 0.1 M Tris‑HCl: 1000 ml, DAB: 500 mg
• Final volume 1500 ml → 0.1 M Tris‑HCl: 1500 ml, DAB: 750 mg

steps.title: Prepare 0.05 % DAB (+H₂O₂) Working Solution for AChE
steps.instruction: When ready to use the AChE stain, add the appropriate volume of 0.03 % H₂O₂ (Table 3) to the DAB‑+ container prepared in the previous step. Do NOT add H₂O₂ until immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Refer to Table 5 for the final volumes (100 ml, 400 ml, 750 ml) and corresponding 0.03 % H₂O₂ volumes:

steps.title: Prepare 0.3 % H₂O₂ Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.3 % H₂O₂ exactly as described for 0.03 % H₂O₂ (see Table 3). The same volumes apply; this solution is used for nickel‑enhanced biocytin staining.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % Nickel Ammonium Sulfate Solution
steps.instruction: Weigh the amount of Nickel Ammonium Sulfate Hexahydrate shown in Table 6 and dissolve it in Milli‑Q water (Table 6). Vortex or stir on a stir plate until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Table 6 (final volumes 20 ml, 50 ml, 100 ml):
• 20 ml → (NH₄)₂Ni(SO₄)₂·6H₂O: 10 mg, Milli‑Q water: 20 ml
• 50 ml → (NH₄)₂Ni(SO₄)₂·6H₂O: 50 mg, Milli‑Q water: 50 ml
• 100 ml → (NH₄)₂Ni(SO₄)₂·6H₂O: 100 mg, Milli‑Q water: 100 ml

steps.title: Prepare Nickel‑Enhanced 0.05 % DAB for Biocytin Staining
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, weigh DAB (Table 8) and dissolve it in 1X PBS (‑) (Table 8). Vortex or stir until clear. Add the appropriate volume of 1 % Nickel Ammonium Sulfate solution (Table 8) and, immediately before use, add the required volume of 0.3 % H₂O₂ (Table 8). Do not add H₂O₂ until just before staining.

substeps.instruction: Table 8 (DAB amounts and PBS volumes):
• Final volume 20 ml → 1X PBS (‑): 20 ml, DAB: 10 mg
• Final volume 50 ml → 1X PBS (‑): 50 ml, DAB: 25 mg
• Final volume 100 ml → 1X PBS (‑): 100 ml, DAB: 50 mg
• Final volume 500 ml → 1X PBS (‑): 500 ml, DAB: 250 mg
Add 1 % Nickel Ammonium Sulfate (Table 8):
• 100 ml → 1 ml
• 500 ml → 5 ml
Add 0.3 % H₂O₂ (Table 8) immediately before use:
• 100 ml → 1 ml
• 500 ml → 5 ml

steps.title: Prepare 0.05 % DAB for Biocytin Staining (No Nickel)
steps.instruction: Repeat the procedure of the previous step but omit the addition of Nickel Ammonium Sulfate. Weigh DAB (Table 8), dissolve in 1X PBS (‑), vortex, and add 0.3 % H₂O₂ (Table 8) immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Use the same DAB and PBS volumes listed in Table 8.
Add 0.3 % H₂O₂ as described in the substeps of the previous step.

steps.title: Store and Dispose DAB Solutions
steps.instruction: Label all prepared DAB solutions and store them at –20 °C. Bring any bottle to room temperature for 15 minutes before weighing. Each DAB working solution is stable for 2 hours from the time of preparation; add hydrogen peroxide immediately before use. Retain any unused DAB solution in appropriately labeled containers for disposal by a licensed hazardous‑waste hauler.
